summary: Iteration 4: Tested Route Tower 4 new features (Shareable public tracking, Bulk CSV import, Smart Alerts, Dark Control-Room theme persistence) + regressions. Backend AI endpoints /api/ai/normalize-csv and /api/ai/alerts return valid JSON with correct schema. Frontend: /track/:id renders read-only WITHOUT app nav (both seed-store and encoded ?d= payload), copy-track-link button on ShipmentDetail copies a valid tracking link containing /track/CT-10245?d=<base64>. Bulk Import modal opens, sample -> AI normalize -> preview -> import all successfully adds shipments (6 -> 9 rows) with toast 'Imported 3 shipments'. Smart Alerts run-scan-btn returned 4 alert rows with alert-open-* links. Dark mode toggle persists via localStorage rt_dark across page reload; toggling back to light also persists. AI insight on ShipmentDetail returns a natural-language insight paragraph. Landing/Dashboard load cleanly, no console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: share.js uses btoa on encodeURIComponent output — works fine for ASCII payloads (~680 chars for CT-10245); consider length guard for huge shipments to avoid URL size limits.
Dashboard rt_dark stored as '1'/'0' strings — consistent. Initial useState reads localStorage synchronously (good, no flash).

BulkImportModal has no per-shipment status validation before addShipment — if AI returns an unknown status value, STATUS[s.status] would be undefined; currently defaults to in_transit in the preview map but the imported shipment retains raw status. Consider normalizing on client too.
aiNormalizeCsv/aiAlerts have no axios timeout; backend has 25s cap so browser could hang if network stalls. Consider a client-side timeout matching backend.
seed_data_creation: None — imported shipments live only in browser localStorage rt_shipments_v1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features + regressions pass. Backend AI endpoints (create-shipment, insight, normalize-csv, alerts) all live via Emergent LLM key with Gemini 3 Flash. AI calls take ~3-8s. Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Public tracking works for both seed shipments (localStorage/seed) and encoded ?d= links. Dark theme persists via localStorage key 'rt_dark' ('1'/'0'). Bulk import adds to rt_shipments_v1.
